evicted.text: I often feel lonely when I'm away from my friends and family, but I try to stay positive. Even when I'm alone, I remind myself that loneliness is a natural part of life, and it can help me grow. Sometimes, being lonely makes me reflect on the people I care about, and that can bring me closer to them. I know that loneliness isn't something to be afraid of—it's just a feeling that comes with being human. And while I sometimes feel lonely, I also find comfort in the moments when I'm not alone. So, even if I feel lonely sometimes, I try to embrace it and use it as a chance to connect with others.
